text: Stoneweg is a Geneva-based investment platform founded about ten years ago by Jaume Sabater, and part of SWI Group, a Euronext Amsterdam-listed group born from the merger of Stoneweg and Icona Capital. In October 2025 the group's fully diluted stake in Stoneweg S.A. rose to 80.26%, giving it control; Max-Hervé George ultimately holds 95.242% of the voting rights in SWI Capital Holding.
short: Stoneweg is 80.26% SWI Capital Holding, 95.242% controlled by Max-Hervé George.
